Chapter 559 - 559 Discussion; Curses

Chapter 559 - 559 Discussion; Curses

559 Discussion; Curses

The banquet lasted until 9 PM before it slowly came to an end.

“Brother, I’m hungry,” Lin Xiaoyao said.

“I guessed it.” Lin Fan smiled and said, “Let’s go. I’ve already gotten someone to prepare supper.”

“Brother, you’re amazing!” Lin Xiaoyao said happily and hugged Lin Fan’s arm.

…

After a while, they arrived at a restaurant that was decorated very grandly.

Just as Lin Fan had said, he had already gotten someone to prepare supper.

In just two minutes, hot skewers, roasted meat, and casserole were served.

“Delicious!”

It was so delicious!

Lin Xiaoyao could not help but praise.

Dai Weixue said, “Eat slowly. Don’t burn yourself.”

…

Lin Fan spent the next two days with his parents and sister in Potholm. Then, he took a luxurious private jet back to Hua Nation.

In the spacious Coiling Dragon Villa, Lin Fan immediately placed his attention on the golden packets.

He muttered, “Let’s see what I can get.”

“Open!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 500,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

[Ding! [Congratulations, you’ve obtained ten cubic meters of inner space.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 900,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100,000 yuan.]

Lin Fan did not care about the 1.6 million yuan at all.

He immediately focused his attention on the ten cubic meters of inner space.

Inner space: [A special space that can instantly store and retrieve objects. It can be used at any time and is extremely fast, adding to its charm.]

Instantly, a white space appeared in Lin Fan’s mind. It was extremely mystical.

He had a very strange feeling that this space was like his hands and feet, and he could use it easily.

Then, Lin Fan turned his gaze to the cup of water beside him.

In the next moment…

The cup appeared in the white space.

With another thought, the cup appeared on the table again.

Seeing this…

Even Lin Fan could not help but reveal a smile that he could not hide. He grinned and said, “I didn’t waste so much time going to Swede to receive the Nobel Prize.”

If other scholars heard this, who knew what kind of expression they would have?

Wasting time to get the Nobel Prize?

In this world, everyone wanted a chance to receive the Nobel Prize.

After a while, Lin Fan finally turned his attention back to the double shares coupon.

“Let’s go with the Alphabet.”

[Ding! The coupon was successfully used. You now own a total of 20% of Alphabet Group’s shares.]

Then, Lin Fan sat on the sofa and continued to play with his phone leisurely.

…

He was relaxed, but some people were extremely nervous.

Alphabet Group’s headquarters.

Zhang Daming was working hard in his office.

At this moment, an email suddenly popped up in the lower right corner of the computer.

In the next moment…

Zhang Daming’s pupils constricted, and his face was filled with anxiety.

“Mr. Lin bought another 10% of the shares, and now he owns 20% of Alphabet!

“What should we do?”

Alphabet Group was founded by Zhang Daming and was his lifeblood.

Now, a large number of shares were being bought by another person.

How could he not be anxious?

Zhang Daming walked around the office a few times.

“Could it be that Mr. Lin is still not satisfied with what happened last time? Yes, that must be it!”

Thinking of this, Zhang Daming quickly made a call.

“Send out the mission. Anyone who criticizes the streamer, Hai Yan, will get double the traffic!”

As a result, after a few weeks, many videos criticizing and mocking Hai Yan appeared on Douyin again.

Originally, Li Haiyan thought that the matter had stopped.

In the end, as soon as she left the house, she was pointed at by countless people.

This made Li Haiyan want to go for plastic surgery.

…

On the other hand, the video about the Nobel Prize award ceremony was still being discussed.

Moving Brick: [I suddenly realized that it’s good enough we were shown a video of Lin Fan’s back. I went to the internet and searched. When Lin Fan was awarded the Nobel Prize, all the cameras of TV stations from other countries malfunctioned. There are no videos or photos of Lin Fan.]

Mo Wen: [Yeah, the reporters are being cursed out by the entire internet.]

Ordinary Person: [What’s going on with the current situation? When Lin Fan held his report, he wasn’t caught by the cameras either. Could it be that the cameras were broken? Is it always so coincidental?]

Long Long: [This… How did Lin Fan do it?]

Free Dream: [Does Lin Fan know magic?]

Hong: [Magic? With that kind of brain, would he still need to use magic? I think it should be some kind of high-tech product, such as some kind of special lens sensor?]

Sleepless: [I’m getting more and more curious about what Lin Fan looks like.]

Skyscraper: [I heard from a teacher at Jiangbei University that Mr. Lin Fan is very handsome. He’s definitely a Prince Charming!]

321 Go: [Is there a need to say that? Just by looking at his back, one can tell that he’s a handsome man who’s 1.8 meters tall!]

Ten Thousand Years With a Glance: [Back view? Jiangbei University? Speaking of this… Did you guys notice that his back view seems a little familiar?]

Period: [Now that you mention it, it does look a little familiar.]

Best Player: [F*ck! I realized that the guy who was accused of theft at Jiangbei University looks very similar to Lin Fan!]

Who: [Their backs are exactly the same!]

…

When someone mentioned this matter, it immediately attracted the attention of many people.

Some experts even compared the two backs and found that their height, body shape, and heads were all exactly the same.

Instantly, everyone understood that the man who was slandered back then was Lin Fan!

When everyone came to this conclusion, the discussions on the internet became even more heated.

East Lake: [F*ck! It’s really the same guy!]

Paper Masked Man: So Tang Yuan was slandering Lin Fan?]

Head of Department: [I actually said that it was a little too serious for the university to give him a major demerit, place him on probation, and even send him to the police to be arrested and detained. Now, it seems his punishment is too light!]

Immortal: [Lin Fan is our pride. Why would he be a thief? Pah!]

Simple: [I say that Tang Yuan should be severely punished!]

If It Was at That Time: [I strongly recommend that Tang Yuan be severely punished!]

Clear Water: [I strongly recommend that Tang Yuan be severely punished!]

…

It had been several days since the slander.

The internet had no memory.

Generally speaking, as long as the matter was over, it would completely be forgotten.

Today, however…

Tang Yuan’s name reappeared on the list of trending searches. He received even more intense criticism than before.
